verses.text: A song for going up to worship. LORD, from the depths of my trouble I cry to you.
Lord, hear my voice. Listen closely to my cry for mercy.
LORD, if you kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
But you forgive us, so we respect you.
I wait for the LORD. My whole being waits for him. I put my hope in his word.
I long for the Lord more than guards long for the morning, more than guards long for the morning.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD, because with the LORD there is faithful love. He is always ready to rescue.
He himself will rescue Israel from all their sins.
